subject: Joint execution slate + MAP draft for Orion Health evaluation
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Joint execution slate + MAP draft for Orion Health evaluation

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the productive conversation yesterday. Per our discussion, I pulled together a short joint execution slate (MAP-style) and an initial evaluation timeline to help us align stakeholders and surface any gating items early.

What I attached / shared:
- neha_map_template_v1.gdoc (editable) — a lightweight MAP with 30/60/90 milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria
- a one-slide kickoff stub (link included in the doc) for the initial workshop

Could you:
1) Confirm the two primary stakeholders on your side who should own acceptance (technical and product)
2) Flag any compliance/security checkpoints we should include up front (SOC2, data retention limits, audit logs)
3) Tell us if a 2-week sandbox then 30-day pilot cadence works, or whether you prefer a compressed pilot window

Proposed next steps: quick 45-minute MAP kickoff workshop the week of Feb 8 to walk the plan and lock owners. I can host and invite the right Redwood folks.

If that works I’ll update the doc with the names you confirm and an initial milestone schedule.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: neha_map_template_v1.gdoc (Google Doc link)

From: Elena Morris <elena@orionhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Peter Chu <peter.chu@orionhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Feb 2027 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Joint execution slate + MAP draft for Orion Health evaluation

Neha — thanks for this and for moving quickly. The doc looks like a good starting point. A few notes from my side: 

- Stakeholders: I'll own product acceptance (Elena Morris) and Peter Chu (CTO) will own the technical acceptance. I'll confirm Peter on the invites.
- Security: we need a SOC2 checklist and confirmation around log retention (we generally ask for 90 days of detailed audit logs and 1 year of coarse usage summaries). Can you add a security checkpoint and an owner for evidence?
- Pilot cadence: we are leaning toward a 2-week sandbox + 30-day pilot, but our procurement lead wants procurement/contract review to happen in parallel since timing is tight.

I've attached a short requirement list from our infra team (orion_requirements.xlsx) — see tabs for network and data residency preferences.

I can do a kickoff the week of Feb 8; preferred times are Tue or Wed mornings.

On the doc: please mark the security checkpoint as high priority and add Jonas as the Redwood technical point.

Thanks,
Elena Morris
VP Product, Orion Health
elena@orionhealth.com

Attachments: orion_requirements.xlsx

Thanks Elena — helpful notes. I made a few edits directly in Neha's doc and added a short kickoff slide deck (MAP_kickoff_slides_v1.gslides) with the proposed agenda:
- 15 min: goals + success metrics (Elena / Peter)
- 15 min: technical checklist + sandbox access (Jonas)
- 10 min: timeline + procurement touchpoints (Neha / Marissa)
- 5 min: immediate next steps and owners

On the security item: Jonas — can you own the evidence collection and point us to the right SIEM/log export formats? We should also note the required retention windows (per Elena) in the map's compliance row.

For the pilot cadence, I recommend we keep the 2-week sandbox + 30-day pilot but prepare a compressed 14-day pilot option in case procurement insists on a faster decision. We can surface both in the MAP under "Milestone options."

Proposed kickoff times: Tue Feb 9, 09:30–10:15 PT or Wed Feb 10, 10:00–10:45 PT. Elena — please pick what works and I'll send the calendar invite + Zoom.

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: MAP_kickoff_slides_v1.gslides

Elena — appreciated. Locking this down:

1) Kickoff: Wed Feb 10, 10:00–10:45 PT — I will send the calendar invite and include Zoom + the doc/slide links.
2) Owners:
   - Product acceptance: Elena Morris (Orion)
   - Technical acceptance: Peter Chu (Orion)
   - Evidence / logs: Jonas Weber (Redwood)
   - Procurement & contracts: Neha Kapoor (Redwood) to coordinate with Orion procurement lead
3) Milestone plan: we will publish both the standard (2-week sandbox + 30-day pilot) and a compressed 14-day pilot option in the MAP under "Milestone options."
4) Security checklist: Jonas, please add the SIEM export format and confirm whether we can provide 90-day detailed logs + 1 year summary (status expected before kickoff).

Elena — if you can confirm attendees (Peter + procurement lead) I will finalize the doc and route a HubSpot entry with the MAP attached to the deal record (link below).
